tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Window canvas: the reading area and the ground every other surface steps from. Code: --bg.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards and side panels, one step off the canvas. Code: --surface.

tokens.name: elevated
tokens.usage: Hover fills, the composer, chips, secondary buttons. Dark lightens upward; light steps darker as a recessed tint. Code: --elevated.

tokens.name: field
tokens.usage: Text inputs. Fields are filled, never outlined. Same rung as elevated today, kept separate so fields can move on their own. Code: --field.

tokens.name: active
tokens.usage: Selected rows and pressed controls, the top of the ramp (bg < surface < elevated < active). Every text and status colour holds 4.5:1 on it. Code: --active.

tokens.name: raised
tokens.usage: Floating layers: menus, popovers, tooltips, toasts. Near-white on light, the elevated rung on dark. Code: --raised.

tokens.name: sidebar
tokens.usage: Left sidebar fill when the frosted sidebar is off. Light sits a shade below the canvas, like paper under a page. Code: --sidebar.

tokens.name: divider
tokens.usage: The only line in the UI: a soft, translucent hairline between groups in lists and menus. It tints whatever it sits on, so it never reads as a hard dark rule. Replaces the opaque value --divider still has in code, which is darker than the surfaces on dark.

tokens.name: divider-strong
tokens.usage: A divider that has to survive a busy area, such as the split between the transcript and a docked panel. The code's --divider-strong is still opaque.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on every surface (12:1+ dark, 10.5:1+ light, including on active). Also the primary button fill. Code: --text.

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Supporting text and resting icons. 6.2:1+ on every surface in both themes. Code: --text-secondary.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Meta, timestamps, section headers, placeholders. 4.5:1+ on every surface, active included. Light darkened from the code's #6c6966 (4.0:1 on active). Code: --text-muted.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Theme-matched neutral accent: near-white on dark, ink on light. Selection, toggles, sliders. Never tints status colours. Code: --accent.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus only (:focus-visible), never on click. A soft 1.5px ring of the accent, the faintest that still reaches 3:1 on every surface. Replaces the code's 1px ring at 60%.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Hyperlinks. Blue so links never read as body text beside the neutral accent. Code: --link.

tokens.name: skill
tokens.usage: Skill invocation labels in the composer and transcript. Code: --skill.

tokens.name: skill-mark
tokens.usage: Rosette mark beside a skill label (an icon, 3:1+). Code: --skill-mark.

tokens.name: visualize-mark
tokens.usage: Visualize plugin mark beside its chip (an icon, 3:1+). Code: --visualize-mark.

tokens.name: ultra
tokens.usage: The top reasoning-effort level, which must read as different by hue. Code: --ultra.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success text, icons and confirm actions: done, passing, additions. 4.5:1+ on every surface. Light darkened from the code's #1f7a4d. Code: --success.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Fill behind success text: a hovered confirm item, a passed badge, a success toast.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warning text and icons: waiting for input, rate limits. 4.5:1+ on every surface. Light darkened from the code's #9a5a0f. Code: --warning.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Fill behind warning text: a waiting badge, a limit banner.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Destructive actions and errors: archive, discard, delete, failed. 4.5:1+ on every surface. Dark lightened from the code's #cf5d54 (3.6:1 on active). Code: --danger.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Fill behind danger text: the hovered destructive menu item, an error banner, a failed badge.

tokens.name: update
tokens.usage: Sidebar update pill fill, both schemes. White text on it is 6.0:1. Code: --update.

tokens.name: update-hover
tokens.usage: Update pill hover. Code: --update-hover.

tokens.name: diff-add-fg
tokens.usage: Added-line text and +N counts (soft diff style, the default).

tokens.name: diff-add-bg
tokens.usage: Added-line background.

tokens.name: diff-add-gutter
tokens.usage: Added-line gutter.

tokens.name: diff-del-fg
tokens.usage: Removed-line text and -N counts.

tokens.name: diff-del-bg
tokens.usage: Removed-line background.

tokens.name: diff-del-gutter
tokens.usage: Removed-line gutter.

tokens.name: diff-hunk-bg
tokens.usage: Hunk header band.

tokens.name: diff-hunk-fg
tokens.usage: Hunk header text (@@ … @@).

tokens.name: brand-ink
tokens.usage: DROIDEX ink: the D of the app icon and the dark icon tile. Brand surfaces only, not app chrome.

tokens.name: brand-paper
tokens.usage: DROIDEX cream: the light icon tile and the X on the dark tile. Brand surfaces only.

tokens.name: brand-orange
tokens.usage: Safety orange: the X of the monogram. The one brand hue; use for the mark and marketing moments, never for UI state.

families.mono: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, "Liberation Mono", "JetBrains Mono", monospace

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The DROIDEX wordmark (BrandMark): Silkscreen, tracking -0.04em at any size, set DROIDE + X so the X can take brand-orange.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Reading surfaces: markdown h1 and the largest page title. Large type runs tight: 1.25 leading, -0.02em.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Reading surfaces: welcome prompt, settings page h1. 1.27 leading, -0.02em.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Reading surfaces: markdown h2/h3, sheet and dialog titles (replaces 17-20px one-offs). 1.22 leading, -0.015em.

styles.name: subheading
styles.usage: Both surfaces: markdown h4, card titles, empty-state headlines. 1.25 leading, -0.01em.

styles.name: prose
styles.usage: Reading surfaces: assistant and user messages, markdown paragraphs and lists. The only style with long-read leading (1.57).
styles.sample: I updated the history reducer so owned records survive a reload.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.usage: Base UI size (--ui-font-size): inputs, primary actions in sheets and onboarding.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Dense surfaces: sidebar and panel rows, menu items, most UI labels.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Dense surfaces: button labels, row titles, selected menu items, tool-call summaries. Medium weight for anything you click.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Dense surfaces: section headers, meta pills, compact buttons, tooltips.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Dense surfaces: timestamps, counts, status lines, keyboard hints (replaces 11.5px). The smallest reading size: looser 1.45 leading and a hair of positive tracking.

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: Badges only (SPEC, AGI): uppercase, 0.08em tracking. Never for sentences.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Code blocks, inline code, terminal (--code-font-size). Tabular figures.

styles.name: code-sm
styles.usage: Diff gutters, line numbers, diff counts.

tokens.name: space-0.5
tokens.usage: Hairline gaps: badge vertical padding, icon nudges.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Tight gaps between icon and count, chip padding.

tokens.name: space-1.5
tokens.usage: Button vertical padding, icon-to-label gap in compact controls.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Default gap in rows and toolbars; row vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-2.5
tokens.usage: Row icon-to-label gap, input vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Row and button horizontal padding, panel insets.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding, input horizontal padding, section top gap.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Composer and sheet padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gaps between sections in settings and dialogs.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Page gutters, empty-state spacing.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Major vertical rhythm: before markdown h1, welcome screen blocks.

tokens.name: icon-sm
tokens.usage: Inline icons inside 12-13px text and dense toolbars.

tokens.name: icon-md
tokens.usage: Default icon size: rows, buttons, composer (the icon package is drawn at 24 and scaled).

tokens.name: icon-lg
tokens.usage: Empty states, the update pill circle.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Icon buttons and compact toolbar controls.

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Default buttons, menu triggers, tabs.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: Inputs and primary actions in sheets and onboarding.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Inline code, tiny badges, scrollbars (absorbs the old 2-3px values).

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Keyboard-shortcut chips, tags, chips inside a button or menu item.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: The control radius for 28–36px controls: buttons, icon buttons, rows, inputs, menu items. Matches the app's rounded-lg (8px).

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Popovers, menus, tool panels: containers about 200–400px that hold radius-md controls (12px).

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, the composer when it floats (16px).

tokens.name: radius-2xl
tokens.usage: Dialogs, large panels and the welcome card. Big surfaces need a bigger radius to look as soft as small ones.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: The send button, round icon buttons, pills, avatars, status dots, the update pill.

shadow.note: Edges come from shadows, not borders: each shadow carries a faint ring (white on dark, ink on light) plus a soft drop.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Tool panels, floating chips, the composer. Carries its own edge (a 4% white ring on dark), so these surfaces need no border. Code: --shadow-sm, softened on light.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, popovers, menus, dialogs. Carries its own soft edge (5% white on dark, 2.5% ink on light), replacing borders. Code: --shadow-lg, softened on light.

tokens.name: shadow-focus-update
tokens.usage: Focus halo on the update pill: a 1.5px hairline of update at 60%. Thinned from the code's 3px at 35%; opacity raised so the thinner ring still reads.

zIndex.note: Stacking order for floating layers, as the Tailwind z-popover, z-dialog, z-toast and z-tooltip utilities.

tokens.name: z-popover
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, dropdowns.

tokens.name: z-dialog
tokens.usage: Dialogs and sheets, above any open popover.

tokens.name: z-toast
tokens.usage: Toasts, above dialogs.

tokens.name: z-tooltip
tokens.usage: Tooltips, always on top.
